seoTitle: How to Create a Rich Filter in Jira (Setup Guide)
metaDescription: Set up smart rich filters in Jira to build advanced dashboards, track KPIs, and visualize project data more effectively for better decisions.
intro: Standard filters can only take your Jira reporting so far, but rich filters let you build more dynamic dashboards for tracking KPIs and project data. This guide walks through creating a rich filter in Jira and adding it to your dashboard as a gadget.

steps.heading: Create a new filter
steps.body: Start by building a saved filter in Jira using your search criteria, such as project, status, or assignee.

steps.heading: Configure smart filter options
steps.body: Adjust the filter's settings to fit the dynamic conditions you want, such as date ranges or issue type combinations.

steps.heading: Add the filter as a dashboard gadget
steps.body: From your Jira dashboard, add a gadget and select your saved rich filter so its results display visually.

steps.heading: Fine-tune the gadget display
steps.body: Adjust how the gadget presents the filtered data, whether as a list, chart, or summary view.

steps.heading: Use it for ongoing reporting
steps.body: Revisit and refine the filter as your project evolves so your dashboard keeps reflecting accurate, up-to-date data.

faq.question: Do I need admin access to create rich filters?
faq.answer: No, most Jira users with standard permissions can create and save filters, though dashboard sharing settings may vary by project.

faq.question: Can I share a rich filter with my team?
faq.answer: Yes, saved filters can be shared with specific users, groups, or the whole project depending on your permissions.

faq.question: How is a rich filter different from a basic search?
faq.answer: A rich filter is a saved, reusable search that you can turn into a dashboard gadget, unlike a one-off basic search.

faq.question: Can rich filters help track sprint velocity?
faq.answer: Yes, when paired with the right gadgets, rich filters can support reporting on completed work and team velocity over time.
